srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/dus rabs gsar ba'i bde skyid 'tsho ba/mtshar sdug nyi gzhon dbang phyogs lhun po'i phyag nas dal bur 'phags pa'i byedzo/ /bdag kyang rkang ba'i 'degs 'jog sgyur bzhin khrom srang gzhung la ltad mor chas/ /'chi med lam du sprin gyi zegs ma byi'u mgo tsam yang mthong rgyu med/ /de'i tshe gser ldan khyon la sngar med yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gzi mdangs bkra/ /mi rigs bod sogs bcu phrag 'ga' yis mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po ru/ /phu nu yin zhes mdza' gcugs yid sems sbrel te rkang ba mnyam gshib kyis/ /'degs 'jog bsgyur ba'i thag sgras dus rabs gsar ba'i bde skyid 'tsho ba de/ /mtshon par byas pas rgan gzhon kun gyi gdong la sngon med 'dzum gyis khengs/ /3
tshangs pa'i thig skud 'phangs 'dra'i mtha' bral gzhung lam de yi lto ba ru/ /dbugs thengs gcig gis rgyug pa'i rlangs 'khor che chung sna mang ji snyed kyis/ /na can bzhi jimangon 'gyur slad du sngon thon mi rigs khag gi rjes 'brangs te/ /phan tshun snga gzhug rtsad nas skyod pa'i tshul 'di e ma ngo mtshar lags/ /srog bral bem por 'di 'dra'i khengs sems dang bcas spobs pa mngon mchis na/ /6 can bzhi mngon 'gyur las don phrag la klu ba'i deng gi gzhon rabs kyis/ /rnying ba mkhregs bzung le lo ngang gis sos dal bag phebs bsdad byas na/ /mi rigs rang gi re ltos byed sa thal ba'i nang du sgyugs min nam/ /grog ma'i tshang la de'u chung 'phangs pa lta bu'i mi tshogs zang ring gis/ /gsar thon zong mang phyogs la mgo bo bsrings nas ngal ba byed pa'am/ /yang na zas mchog mngar mo'i ro la sred de rang srog phangs med sgos/ /'tshang kha shig shig byed 'di ci yin gang yin bdag gis dpag ma nus/ /4
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/snum nag dar skud 'then 'dra'i dkyel che yangs pa'i khod snyoms gzhung lam de/ /'dzam gling srid pa'i rtser mor grags pa 'bar ba'i gnas mchog mtsho sngon gyi/ /yid 'ong khang bzang tshar du dngar ba'i grong khyer chen po zi ling zhes/ /snyan pa don dang bcas pa'i bzhi mdo chen po'i srang gi khor yug lags/ /de ru rgyan gos sna mang spras pa'i yar skyes pho mo rgan gzhon rnams/ /mi rigs khyad chos mngon par mtshon pa'i bod pa'i spro tshogs ltad mor chas/ /de yis 'dren byed zung gi gzi dpal cig car nyid du 'phrog pa yis/ /dus rabs gsar ba'i bde skyid 'tsho ba mngon sum mtshon par byas min nam/
dga' ston snang 'char yid dga'i phreng ba/—rib sa'i bdun pa'i spro tshogs la phul pa/gleng slong ba'i gtam/rtags dang mtshan ma mngon par bkra ba'i bkra shis dus kyi nyin mo la/ /khri gdugs nyi ma'i gzi byin 'phos tshe dga' skyid 'dzoms pa'i yul sde ru/ /ltas bzang ma bos ngang gis slebs pa'i dga' spro kun gyi ngag sgo las/ /bde skyid mngon rdzogs(bdun pa'i spro tshogs gleng mo dbyar rnga ldir bzhin grags/ /skyes skyes pho mo rgan gzhon kun gyis rtag tu sems pa'i blor 'char ba'i/ /skyid skyid re ba'i sems kyi nyi gzhon bde dga'i klong na 'dzum grol ba/ /dga' dga' gling la rab mched snyan pa skyi bser rlung la 'grogs pa'i gtam/ /bde bde zhing gi dga' ston yo lang yongs su rgyas pa'i dpal dang mtshungs/ /6
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/bgres song rgan rgon nyi mar ldes te nam rgyun ja chang gleng bar rtsom/ /stag shar gzhon rnams dgyes pa'i gtam la rang gi rtsed ston yongs su ngoms /dman chung mo gsar yid sems 'phreng ba glu gar rtsed rigs phyogs der chags/ /na chung byis rnams dga' bas rtsed bzhin rang rang kha zas gleng la brel/ /yul spyir bstan pa/gangs can sman ljongs 'dzin ma'i rgyan cha mdo smad g.yang gi khor mo yug /brjid chags sa 'dzin bang rim phreng bzhin bltar la brgyus shing bskor ba'i yul/ /rma klung dal 'bab bzhur rgyun snyan pa'i lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i zhing mchog tu/ /reb gong gser ljongs rig pa'i 'byung gnas lo rgyus ring mo brtan par gnas/ /bya khyung lhun po ker ker brjid pa'i 'dabs rol mdzes pa'i yul ljongs mchog /gong mo rdza ri brtan brtan 'gying ba'i mdun phyogs sa yi me long ngos/ /dgu 'dus chu mo lhung lhung 'bab pa'i g.yon phyogs sa 'dzin gzhung rgyud du/ /7
no'u chu sngon mo gya gyur bzhur ba'i g.yas phyogs 'dzin ma'i lto ba na/ /a sngon gnam 'degs ka bar 'khrul ba'i yang steng 'phrul gyi zhing khams su/ /smug rgyu'i klong du dri za'i pho brang thad mar 'gying 'dra'i gnas mchog zhing / /sprin dkar tshom bu skad cig ma bor bal ldan khyu tshogs 'dus pa 'dra'i/ /gna' po'i yul sde phal mo phyug der ngo mtshar rgyan cha 'dogs la rings/ /rab mdzes spang du me tog sna tshogs mgo lcog snyom por ldem zhing g.yo/ /rab snyan mgrin pa'i glu len mkhas pa rkang ba drug ldan 'phur lding rtsen/ /rab mang rta nor lug gsum khyu rnams mchong lding gar la rol dang lhan/ /rab dga' rdzi bo'i skyed glu snyan mo drug 'gyur dbyangs dang 'grogs te 'chor/mu mtha' mi mngon sa zhing steng na 'bru drug snye mas mgo lcog ldem/ /las la brel ba'i dman chung bzang mos zhing nang rtswa ldum 'bal ba'i tshe/ /stag shar gzhon rnams ma bos ngang 'dus mtha' la yongs su bskor dang lhan/ /'dod brtse'i gtam la rjes chags mgrin las ngag gi sta gon yang yang bgyid/ / 8
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/yul sde byang 'khor brtse ldan skyed mas bu phrug pang du blangs 'dra ru/ /rgan brtsi gzhon gces drang bden ngag las gtam snyan rtag tu smra bar brtson/ /phyug bsgyur sgo mo'i jus bzang bltar bas rgyu 'byor rnam sras mdzod 'gran zhing / /phu nu'i mdza' brtse 'o mtsho rab 'phyur ngo mtshar yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /tshar du dngar ba'i ras gur phreng ba/a sngon nam mkha'i pha mtha' de ru lho bzhud byang la rgyu ba yi/ /sprin dkar tshom bu me tog brdal 'dra 'dzin ma'i lto bar 'phangs pa'am /yang na spang ljongs sngon mo'i dbus su bag phebs gang sar rgyu ba yi/ /g.yang dkar lug gi khyu tshogs ngoms med ram dkar rtswa la rol lam ci/ /ci 'di 'chi med lam na dal bur rgyu ba'i sprin tshom ma yin zhing / /spang ljongs sngon mo'i dbus su bkram pa'i bal ldan khyu tshogs ma yin te/ /mes po'i lag shes 'phrul las gtams pa'i rab dkar gzhal yas khang bzang dag /skar tshogs ji bzhin mngon sum 'char ba'i ras gur sa gzhir phub 'di mdzes/ /9
chu 'dzin phon po sa la babs 'dra'i ngo mtshar ras kyi gur khang du/ /gru bzhi sho 'dra'i cog tse rim bltar mngar ldan shing tog sna tshogs rigs/ /sha mar thud kyi sder skal mdun bshams ngo mtshar blo las 'gongs pa dag /dri za'i ljongs kyi zas sna yod dgu mi yul 'di la drangs par dogs/ /kha dog sna lnga'i bzo bkod legs pa bsil ldan ljongs kyi cha lugs nyid/ /dri ldan spos shing snom byed drangs pas phyogs kyi dri za ring nas bkug /ja chang zung gi snod brgya gtams te mi rnams dga' ba ngang gis 'phel/ /thams cad zas mngar sha la rjes chags ri spyang sngon mo lhan 'grogs bzhin/ /sna tshogs ras gur bltar la brgyus pa'i phyi nang sgo yi khor yug kun/ /bag phebs rtsed 'jor ngang gis rol ba'i byis chung gzhon rnams gang sar rgyu/ /rgan rgon rnam pas phyag rten thogs te khyar khyor gom pa spo bzhin du/ /yun ring re sgug spro tshogs 'di yi ngo mtshar ltad mor chas te 'gro /yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rig rtsal do ra/snyan 'jibs dga' spro'i glu sgra sna tshogs gzugs med bar snang khyab dang lhan/ /10
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/'dab chags khyu yis ma bzod mgrin pa gzengs bteg rna ba glags nas gsan/ /ldem myur stangs stabs ngoms pa'i pho gsar mo gzhon gar stabs bsgyur ba'i tshe/ /'chi med sgeg mo stong yang ma bos ngang gis slebs par sta gon byed/ /smin legs sgeg ldan bu mo rnams kyis lag gdang sbrel nas gar la rol/ /stag shar pho gsar gzhon nu rnams kyis snyan pa'i pi wang rol cha dkrol/ /bag yangs rtsed 'jor g.yeng spro byis rnams mngar cha'i zas sna ngoms so bgyi/ /dbu skra dkar po'i bgres song rgan rnams a rag 'thung zhor spro glu len/ /lag zung gong mos 'dab gshog brkyangs 'dra'i nus pa'i rtsal stobs ci dgar ngoms//mgo 'phang yar dgye brang khog phyir bsrings rab rgyas nu 'bur dbyibs mngon zhing //dar tshon sna lnga'i 'ja' gur phubs 'dra'i sna tshogs gos kyis legs brgyan pa/ /rma bya'i sgro gur phub dang 'dra ba'i mo gsar zhabs bro'i sgeg nyams mdzes/ /11
glu ngag sgo mo yongs phyes la la'i skad gdangs mgrin bzang skad kyi grogs/ /kha cig skad gdangs phra bar len pa rgyud mangs gnyom skad 'gran pa dang / /'ga' zhig skad gdangs snyan par thon pa rkang ba drug ldan rjes 'gro zhing / /re zhig skad gdangs ha cang dma' ba zab mo dong nang len pa bzhin/ /lta na sdug pa'i lus rtsal 'gran tshogs/spang sngon thang na rta mchog rgod pos bang rtsal stobs kyis 'gran pa'am/ /yang na bde mo thang du 'phrul bzos 'phrul rta gcig mgyogs gcig 'gran yin/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo sna tshogs mig brgya sprul nas bltas kyang mi langs pa/ /gang yang ma yin stag shar gzhon rnams mnyam gshib rkang rgyug 'gran pa'i tshul/ /lnga phrag zung 'dus pho gzhon mo gzhon mnyam gnas gcig tu bsdu rub kyis/ /zhags pa'i sne la dam bzung rang rang la rgya 'dzin pa'i dpa' nyams ston/ /shed mo stobs chen 'phrul gyis 'drud pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo ci rigs de/ /tshan bgos hur gyis 'bad cing lhan 'dus lus rtsal thag 'then 'gran pa'i tshul/ /12
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/rgya stag dmar yag nags su mchong stangs 'gran pa'i do zla ma yin zhing / /nyams chung gla bo brag tu lding ba'i gom stabs zil gyis gnon byed pa/ /byi'u chung co ku'i 'phur lding phra mo yud kyis gcod pa'i nyams snang de/ /pho gsar gzhon rabs rnams kyis phreng bsgrigs lus rtsal rgyang lding 'gran pa'i tshul//drag po'i rtsal ldan rdzu bag zol gyis khang klad lding ba'i 'phrul shugs dang / /'bur de'u sgang na ri bong gnam lding dpa' nyams ston pa'i tshul 'chos zol/ /rgyun par nga'o snyam pa'i khongs ldan dag gis rang rtsal ngoms pa de/ /pho gsar gzhon rabs rnams kyis phreng bsgrigs lus rtsal mtho lding 'gran pa'i tshul//a pho zung la shed stobs nus rtsal 'dra zhes ngar stobs 'don pa dang / /phan tshun res 'thab bskor thengs 'ga' byas rgyal pham dbye ba 'byed dka' zhing / /dpung tshugs rkang brtan 'dra mnyam yin zhes phar g.yug tshur g.yug byed pa de/ /pho gsar gzhon rabs rnams kyis phreng bsgrigs lus rtsal 'ju res 'gran 13
pa'i tshul//mtha' na yongs bskor rgan gzhon pho mos mig ni mi btsum ring cer zhing / /la la dgod bro zhal gyi tshems phreng bang rim phyi la bltar ba dang / /ha ha dgod sgras khor yug kun kyang rang bzhin ngang gis zang zing gyur/ /la las grung sha grim pos lus gzur rang tshugs bzod dka'i gnas su lhung / /gzhon nu'i spro 'phel rig rtsal dgong tshogs/e ma bco lnga'i dung zla 'char dus yul sde'i khor yug dben thing thing / /rgyang ring grong na glog ldan phreng rnams mkha' yi rgyu skar tshogs bzhin bkra/ /sgo khyi mang po'i zug skad ring bos mtshan gyi mgron po'i gnyid dkrog tshe/ /pho mo gzhon gsar mnyam 'dus byed 'di spro tshogs skabs kyi dgong tshogs lags/ /mi tshogs gras na brtse ba'i zol gyis mdza' glu len pa'i pho mo zung / /skad ngag snyan la yag btsog med par phan tshun glu gzhas 'gran pa de/ /gzhas lab tshig rnams mi tshar gzhas brgya snyan pa'i ngag gcig len pa'am/ /yang na skad kyi gdangs dbyangs mi 'dra ngag brgya gzhas gcig len nam 14

'gran bral slob dpon spyi bor mchod pa'i yul/bcu phrag rig pa'i lo 'dab g.yur du za/ /za 'og ri mos phyug pa'i yon tan mdzod/ /mdzod du shes bya ji snyed gtams pa'i mgon/ /mgon khyed spyi bo'i gtsug tu mchod par 'os/ /rgyu skar skar tshogs dbus na zla gzhon bzhin/ /blo gsal gzhon nu'i dbus na dam pa khyed/ /spyi por mchod pa'i me tog phreng ba ni/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin pa'i rgyan du gyur/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung legs bshad rin chen gter/ /mtha' la thug kyang dam pa'i zhal gsung rgyun/ /dal 'bab ring mo ji bzhin 'dzad med pas/ /blo ldan skye bo'i skom gdung yongs su sel/ /48
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/khyed zhal skabs gsum gnas kyi do ra nas/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi bsil ma'i nying khu gtor/ /de'i tshe ngoms med btung ba'i gsar skyes gzhon/ /snga gzhug rtsad nas mi 'ongs su zhig mchis/ /phyogs ris mig dbang 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /rang gi grub mtha'i las der phyogs pa las /kun dang mi mthun bzhin mdangs sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /mgon khyed ris med blo gros gzhan las yangs/ /tshan rtsal ming tshig gsar ba'i brjod bya'i don/ /'khrul med ston pa'i lam gyi cha de ru/ /lhug por brjod pa sbrang char bsil ma'i rgyun/ /chad med 'jo ba'i las 'di khyed kyi drin/ /22can bzhi'i lam du zhugs pa'i ldang rta che/ /kha lo bsgyur la mgon khyed spobs pa'i ngang / /deng yang mi sdod rtsibs stong 'gros dang bcas/ /skye dgu'i mig gi ltad mor zhugs la rings/49
blang dor gnas 'di shes par gyis/pha ma byams sems ldan dang gcig /bu phrug brtsi bkur che dang gnyis/ /mna' ma gzhung rgyud drang ba gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na khyim tshang skyid/ /pha mas gces lang btang dang gcig /bu phrug ngan la phyogs dang gnyis/ /mna' ma g.yo sgyu che ba gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na khyim tshang sdug /bshes gnyen dam par bsten dang gcig /nyin mtshan med par sbyangs dang gnyis/ /bsam gzhig yang yang gtong ba gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na yon tan ldan/ /50
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/slob dpon gsung la mi nyan gcig /rang gi bya ba bskyur dang gnyis/ /tha mag chang la dga' ba gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na yon tan dkon/ /tang gi srid jus bzang dang gcig /mi rigs mthun sgril dam dang gnyis/ /rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor 'phel ba gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na rgyal srid dar/ /'go khrid kha la mi nyan gcig /phan tshun dkrugs shing 'phen dang gnyis/ /nam rgyun 'khrug rtsod byed pa gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na rgyal srid nyams/ /rang bskyur gzhan don khur dang gcig /dmangs phan dge ba bsgrubs dang gnyis/ /gnyom chung brtse bas bskyangs pa gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na snyan grags rgyas/ /51
dbyen dang kha mchu mang dang gcig /rgyu nor lkog za byed dang gnyis/ /kun spyod cha lugs ngan pa gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzoms na snyan grags nyams/ /
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/bkra shis ngag gi dbyangs rta/tang gi jus bzang nyin byed 'bar ba'i 'od kyis gangs ljongs gsal ba'i bkra shis shog /mi rigs skad yig bya gzhag nyin bzhin lhod med gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i spun zla mi rigs mdun du bskyod pa'i bkra shis shog /rang skyong bca' khrims sbrang char bsil ma gangs ljongs yul grur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /mi rigs so so mthun sgril 'dra mnyam dbyer med spun ltar brtse ba'i bkra shis shog /mi rigs tshang ma chu dang nya mo bzhin du yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /byams brtse drin gyis bskyangs pa'i drin chen pha ma tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog /ma 'ongs re ltos byed yul bu dang bu mo blo rig rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /53
'chad rtsod rtsom la brel ba'i mkhas mchog rgyu skar bzhin du mchis pa'i bkra shis shog /zhing la lo legs smin te 'bru yis bang mdzod phyur bur gtams pa'i bkra shis shog /phyugs la sha shed 4rgyas shing mar chur ri bzhin spungs pa'i bkra shis shog /sa la dge bcu 'dzoms shing yul la dga' ba'i ltas bzang mngon pa'i bkra shis shog /54
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/srog gi gshed ma tha mag spang bar mdzod/bsam ngan dug dang 'dra ba'i tha mag smra sgor drangs pa yis/ /rin chen sku lus steng gi byed po srog la gnod bskyal nas/ /bcos thabs bral ba'i nad ngan khrag gi rtsa lam rgyu ba yis/ /deng rabs gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams kyi srog kyang 'phrog par byed/ /mdog legs spus ldan nad med rtag pa'i khog gi glo ba yang / /mi 'dod tha mag dug gis bsam bzhin nag po'i mdog tu bsgyur/ /glo ba'i yu ba dngul gyis bzos pa'i sbru gu lta bu de/ /lcags kyi thab ma'i du khung nag po bzhin du gyur 'di skyo/ /da dung pho ba mchin dang mkhal mar skran nad 'byung ba de/ /lus la gnod par byed pa'i tha mag dug gis bzos pa yin/ /lnga ba'i lam du 'dren mkhas dug gi nying khu tha mag 'di/ /mchog dman bar ma'i skye bo kun gyis gtan du spang bar mdzod/ /tsho55
mi la dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i lus po rin chen 'di/ /sku tshe yun ring gnas par 'dod pa'i thugs 'dun mngon mchis kyang //dri ngan tha mag ces pa gnod byed bdud kyi dbang bo des/ /skad cig nyid du 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul la bde bar bskyal/ /spyi lo chig stong brgyad brgya bzhi bcu'i god chags chen po'i nang / /rang phan gzhan la gnod par bsam pa'i dbyin ji btsan rgyal pas/ /dri ngan tha mag 'di yi gnyen po nyal tha dug rdzas kyis/ /dmag 'khrug langs par byas 'di lo rgyus deb las ma mthong ngam/ /drin chen pha ma dug ngan 'di la mos shing spyad byas na/ /bza' mi gang bo tha rdzas 'di yis nad du 'gyur bar nges /dge rgan kha la tha mag rkang gcig btsugs nas btsan gtam gyis/ /slob mar gshe gshe gtong ba'i thabs bkod 'di yang 'os sam ci/ /sku la gzhon sha rgyas shing lang tsho chud zos gtong ba dang / /yong sgo nyung ba'i dngul sgor de yang don med me la bsregs/ /zla mjug khug stong byas nas gzhan la bu lon 'jal ba yi /rjes su rang gi gon pa yin yang gta' mar 'jog par nges/ /56
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/btsun pa kha shas kyi bya spyod mtshang 'byin byed pa/ngur smrig gos gyon rab byung ba dag khyed kyis tshur la gson/ /yid sems drang ba'i bden don gtam gyi rol mo 'di na dkrol/ /rab byung btsun pa'i tshul der dad dmangs spro zhing yid smon 'chor/ /yin yang cha lugs ngan pa'i cho 'phrul mthong na yid re skyo/ /sdom dang tshul khrims gtsang zhes kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /mi mngon lkog na chang dang gnod brgya'i rtsa ba tha mag la/ /longs spyod 'dod pa'i sems pa dam por bzung yang mi thub pas/ /a rogs las 'dir ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /blo rno brtson 'grus ldan zhes kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /rtag tu yid la chags sems skyes te rang gi ming bor nas/ /bstan pa'i dgra ru gyur te kun gyis mi 'dod zhe mer bas/ /a rogs las 'dir ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /57
klog dang 'don la byang zhes kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /khong na phrag dog me bzhin 'bar zhing nga rgyal du bzhin 'phyur/ /mchog dman kun la smod cing rang las gzhan zhig med snyam pas/ /a rogs las 'dir ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /dpa' dang 'gran zla bral zhes kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /khong khro me lce bzhin 'bar zhe sdang du nag ltar 'phyur nas/ /nam yang gri mdung mtshon cha bzung nas gzhan la 'phya bzhin pas/ /a rogs las 'dir ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /sha dang spun grogs mang zhes kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /rang gi las la mi gnyer gzhan pa'i gtam gyi rjes zhugs nas/ /kha mchu rtsod gleng slong 'dod yid la dga' spro rgyas bzhin pas/ /a rogs las 'dir ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /rgyab rten rtsa ba yod ces kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /don med rnam g.yeng dang ni le lo'i dbang gyur te/ /mi ngan khram pa dag gi rjes zhugs khyi rgan ltar gyur pas/ /a rogs las der ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /58
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/skad ngag gnyis ka 'dzoms zhes kun la ngoms so byed 'dug kyang / /dben pa'i grong na lkog tu gzhas dang deng rabs rol dbyangs la/ /nyan zhing zhabs bro dang ni rtse rigs sna tshogs rtsed bzhin pas/ /a rogs las 'dir ma zhugs rnam dag btsun pa'i cha lugs zungs/ /
myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/blo rig rmongs pa tha gus bsgril par byed/ /shes pa mi gsal mun pas g.yogs pa dang / /nam rgyun sgyid lug le lo'i khrod gnas pas/ /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /lus kyi dbang bo skad cig nyams byed pa/ /mi gtsang skyug dang bshang gci nang du zhugs/ /smra brjod mi gsal don med 'ur sgrog pas/ /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /nyin dang mtshan gyi dbye ba 'byed mi thub/ /bdag gzhan gnyis kyi don kun 'grub mi srid/ /pha dang ma yang mig nang gdon 'gyur pas/ /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /60
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/rtsom la mkhas kyang snyan grags rgyas mi srid/ /gso la mkhas kyang nad ngo len mi thub/ /bzo la mkhas kyang khab mig mi mthong bas /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /rdzun dang g.yo sgyus grogs kyang bslu bar byed/ /dge sdig gnyis kyi spang blang nyams byed pa/ /gzhan dbang nor la ham pa cher bskyed pas/ /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /yid la shar ba thams cad sdig pa'i las/ /lag len byed pa thams cad 'phya ba'i gnas/ /kha las brjod pa thams cad zhe mer bas/ /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /smad 'tshong kha la rgyugs shing de la spro/ /rgyu nor thams cad ma lus phyi la btsong / /bza' zla bu phrug tshang mas sdug myong bas/ /myos byed chang de spongs shig pha bzang bu/ /61
bod mi'i bsam pa dga' song /nyi gzhon gyi 'od snang sa gzhi yi phang bar 'phros dus/ /gangs ri yi phug las dwangs gsal gyi chu phran bzhur byung / /gshin po yi zhing sar dwangs gtsang gi chu rgyun drangs pas/ /zhing las la brel ba'i bod mi yi sems pa dga' song / /lang long gi sprin pa a sngon gyi mkha' ru 'phyur dus/ /zim zim gyi sbrang char bar snang gi khams nas babs byung / /sngo ljang gi sa gzhir dkar dmar gyi me tog bkra bas/ /phyugs las la brel ba'i bod mi yi sems pa dga' song / /g.yu 'brug gi grags skad a sngon gyi dgung la khyab dus/ /mdzes sdug gi spu ris mdangs ldan gyi rma bya myos byung / /yid 'ong gi mjug sgro gser bum gyi kha ru brgyan pas/ /rten 'brel la brtag pa'i bod mi yi sems pa dga' song / /62
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/yang dag gi jus bzang pe cin gyi mkhar nas sgrog dus/ /gangs ri yi ljongs su bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar byung / /lag zung gi snyim pas dad pa yi rten de mtshon pas/ /'dzum mdangs kyis khengs pa'i bod mi yi sems pa dga' song / /mi rigs kyi me tog dga' tshal gyi dpal yon rgyas dus/ /mes rgyal gyi khyim la bkra shis kyi dge mtshan rgyas byung / /mi rigs kyi zla gzhon 'phel 'gros kyi skal ba thob nas/ /re smon la goms pa'i bod mi yi sems pa dga' song / /63
dus bzhi'i bu mo'i rtsod gleng /dpyid/ka ye rna ba gzhan la ma g.yeng tshur gson dang / /sa gzhir sngo ljang gos kyi lwa ba nga yis bskon/ /dgun dus mal du gzims pa'i srog chags nga yis bsgul/ /dpyid kyi na chung mdzes ma bdag nyid kun las rgyal/ /dbyar/kye kye glen ma khyod kyis de skad ma bshad cig /ljon shing 'dab ma'i lo ma ches cher nga yis bskyed/ /dwangs gsal mkha' las sbrang char bsil ma nga yis drangs/ /dbyar gyi sgeg mo nga nyid khyed cag kun las lhag /ston/ka ye zhing pa'i 'bru mdzod yongs gtams nga yi drin/ /rta nor lug la sha shed rgyas pa nga yi drin/ /mkha' yi nyi ma'i tsha grang snyoms por nga yis byas/ /64
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/'bras ldan dus kyi mdza' mo khyed cag kun las rgyal/ /dgun/he he nga yis sa gzhir kha ba'i gos dkar g.yogs/ /dwangs gtsang rab med chu bor dar gyi ske rags bcings/ /tsha gdung mnar ba'i mi la 'khyag bsil rlung gis g.yab/ /dgun gyi na chung bu mo khyed cag rnams las rgyal/ /65
nyes can zhig gi skyo glu/pha yul phyogs tsam mthong na dga' ba la/ /btson gyi ra ba mtho bas mthong lam bkag /pha ma'i zhal ras mthong na dga' ba la/ /sa thag ring bo'i lam gyis mthong lam bkag /spro ba'i glu skad thog na dga' ba la/ /rang nyid gcig pu gnas pas thos lam bkag /khu byug dbyangs snyan thos na dga' ba la/ /dus bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur khrod nas thos lam bkag /pha ma spun mched bsam na dga' ba la/ /rang sems sdug gis bcings pas bsam lam bkag /sbrang dkar rtsam pa bsam na dga' ba la/ /sngo ldum dri ma 'thul bas bsam lam bkag /66
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/pha yul dran pa'i mchi ma dbang med lhung / /yul mis mthong na bu chung snying re rje/ /snying rje'i bu chung mun nag btson du bcug /sngon byas las la 'gyod kyang 'phyi ba yin/ /rgyal khrims rdo rje ri la gzhom gzhig bral/ /khrims 'gal mi la ris med rgyal khrims mkho/ /deng phyin 'di 'dra ma byed skye bo rnams/ /nga yi snying gtam yid la bzung bar gyis/ /67
cang shes rta yi khyad rtags/—rab rgyal lcags rta lor rang lo nyer lnga lon pa'i na mnyam grogs po rnams la phul pa/spang thang g.yu lo rgyas pa'i ne'u gsing gzhir/ /rkang lag rtsal gyis mchong lding gar bsgyur ba'i/cang shes rta pho'i gzugs de mthong ma thag /bdag gi mig zung dbang med de gar phyogs/ /rta mchog khyed la ma bcibs da lta'i bar/ /lo 'khor bcu gnyis zla tshes rim gyis 'das/ /zla tshes skar bzang bkra shis nyin mo la/ /'tsher ba'i skad de snyan pa'i dbang bor drangs/ /ring nas goms pa'i byed po sgra brgya ba/ /'dris ma thag pa'i rkang lag brgya ba gnyis/ /skyes 'gro kun dang yun ring 'phrad legs kyang / /rta mchog khyed nyid nam phebs thengs mang dris/ /68
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/bkra shis lha rnga'i dbyangs dang 'grogs pa las/ /cang shes rta zhes snyan pa phyogs bcur khyab/ /de'i tshe rkang lag zung gi thag gra yis/ /skye dgu'i gdong nas sngar med 'dzum mdangs brtas/ /skyi bser rlung gi do zla byed nus na/ /bya rgod 'phur ba'i shugs la smos ci 'tshal/ /thang chen yangs por gom kha bsgyur ba'i tshe/ /'brog pa'i bu phrug dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis khongs/ /cang shes rta mchog khyed nyid mthong ma thag /khengs sems dang bcas mgo 'phangs gnam la gtad/ /de ni mes po'i shul bzhag mdzad rjes rnams/ /zhabs kyis spyi bor mchod pa'i mtshan rtags nyid/ /ring thung gral snyoms gnya' yi rngog ma de/ /mthon por gzengs pa'i tshul la brtag pa na/ /mi rigs las byed 'tshar longs byung dang lhan/ /tshan rtsal lag rjes mi dman 'jog pa'i rtags/ /69
dkar 'jam mdzes sdug spu mdangs yongs bkra ba/ /gangs ri'i ljongs su gnas pa'i mi rigs 'di/ /spun zla mi rigs gral na lhang nge bar/ /rang rgyud sems pa dung ltar dkar ba'i rtags/ /rkang lag zung gi gom rtsal myur ba de/ /chab dpal rig gsum las don gong 'phel ngang / /sngon thon mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra mnyam gyis/ /mdun skyod khrod du phan tshun 'gran pa'i rtags/ /rta mchog khyed kyi mjug ma ring bo de/ /thur du 'phyang nas sa dang mnyam pa 'di/ /mi rigs lo rgyus chu rgyun ring mo bzhin/ /chad med yun ring gnas pa'i rtags mtshan lags/ /e ma kun gyis re ba'i 'dun bcol ba'i/ /cang shes rta mchog khyed kyi gshis rgyud de/ /kha ba ri bo'i bdag por yongs mtshungs pas/ /yid sems dungs pa'i tshul de brjod mi langs/ /70
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/khyed kyi 'tsho yul gangs ljongs khrod du gnas/ /khyed kyi bza' chas rtswa mchog ram dkur dang / /khyed kyi bdag po gangs ri'i ljongs su mchis/ /khyed kyi rmig rjes ma bor yul 'dir 'khod/ /gser sga phra mo rgya nag mdzod las drangs/ /dngul gyi yob chen rgya gar yul nas nyos/ /srab mda'i ko ba kha ba'i ljongs nas bzos/ /'di gsum rta mchog khyed kyi lus na mdzes/ /bkra shis zla skar tshes bzang nyin mo la/ /rta mchog rgod po'i 'tsher skad gang sar khyab/ /yul phyogs kun la dge mtshan yongs rgyas te/ /dga' ba'i dga' ston mchog la rol cig gu/ /71
drin chen dge rgan snying nas dran/dri bral rab dkar thugs yangs lha lam ngos/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i skar tshogs mang bkra zhing / /mkhyen dpyod gnyis kyi klong yangs brdol pa yi/ /bshes gnyen mchog gi bka' drin snying nas dran/ /gang zhig dbyar gyi dpal mo mngon pa'i tshe/ /bdag blo'i mkha' la chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs/ /yon tan bye ba'i bsil char slob bu la/ /yongs su sbyin mkhan slob dpon snying nas dran/ /sprin bral sngo bsangs rdzing ring yangs pa las /nyin mo'i mgon gyi 'od snang 'bar ba'i gzis/ /chu skyes pad mo'i 'dab stong lhug grol mkhas/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa khyed rang snying nas dran/ /72
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/gang zhig khyed nyid rgyu skar rgyal po yis/ /shes bya bdud rtsi'i zer brgya spros pa des/ /gangs can gzhon nu'i skyed tshal rgyas dang lhan/ /blo gsal ku mud bzhad mkhas slob dpon dran/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i las la rab spro ba'i/ /slob dpon khyed nyid lnga rig gnas kyis phyug /khyed kyis bskyangs pa'i gsar skyes slob bu tshogs/ /shes bya'i gnas la 'jug bzhin khyed nyid dran/ /rnam dpyod rig pa'i gru gzings pha rol la/ /song nas yon tan nor bu len 'dod kyang / /bshes gnyen ded dpon mchog la ma brten na/ /nor bu len thabs bral bas slob dpon dran/ /dpyid kyi pho nyas gsung dbyangs 'byin pa yis/ /sa gzhi kun la sngo ljang gos kyis bklubs/ /slob dpon khyed kyi dri med gsung rgyun las/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i mun pa yongs su sel/ /73
mchog mchog slob dpon mchog khyed dran pa'i tshe/ /gdung gdung yid sems skyo gdung gis mnar yang / /legs legs shes bya legs bshad dri med de/ /gzhon gzhon blo gsal gzhon nur sbyin 'di spro/ /
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/rgyal ston bsu ba'i legs skyes/lo 'khor bzhi bcu'i sngon gyi dus bzang nyin byed dbang bo yar 'phags tshe/ /mi rigs kun gyi 'thus tshab gnas mchog rgyal sa pe cin mkhar la 'dus/ /rgyal kha'i glu dbyangs phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun la dal gyis khyab pa yis /brjid ldan grong na skar lnga'i dar dmar rlung dang 'grogs nas dgung la bsnyegs/ /lo zla mang po'i ring la 'bangs rnams gnya' nas gnon mkhan de dag gis/ /mig gi mdangs 'phrog gzi ldan rgyal rtags mthong tshe skrag nas bla 'dar zhing / /mgrin pa'i ngag las 'khun sgra thon zhing mi mngon lkog la yib na'ang / /yang dag tang gi jus bzang gsar bas bden don khrims kyi gnya' shing bskon/ /'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur krung hwa mes rgyal 'di yi mnga' khongs su/ /75
mi rigs nga drug me tog tshom bur bkod bzhin ming sring spun zla'i brtse dungs chags/ /srid 'byor rig slob la sogs las don gong du 'phel ba'i gtam bzang de/ /dmangs kyi sgra 'dzin dbang bor zhugs tshe spro dga' rgyas nas tang la bstod/ /rlabs chen tang gi 'go 'dren bzang po nyin byed zer brgya'i 'od snang gis/ /mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kun gyi yid sems pad mo gsar bzhad de/ /bstod pa'i glu dbyangs chad med rkang drug bung ba'i dbyangs snyan ji bzhin du/ /kun gyi thos 'dzin lam du snyan dbang gso ba'i bdud rtsir gyur 'di mtshar/ /76
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/gsom dkar ljon pas bton pa'i smre ngagkhor yug mdzes phyir nga rang nor 'dzin gzhi la 'gying nger 'greng / /kha ba bu yug sog le lta bus yal 'dab glo bur bcom/ /drag char rlung gis sngo ljang lo ma'i gdong yongs bran par byas/ /yin yang mchi ma tsam las smre ngag gcig kyang bton ma myong / /gsom dkar shing zhes ljon pa'i gras na nga la brjid nyams ldan/ /lha shing ljon pas 'khyag grang dus su gyon gos gsar ba bklubs/ /dbyar sdong lo ma don med thang la gtor te rlung gis khur/ /nga yis dbyar dgun med par gos sngon lus la mnabs nas yod/ /brjid nyams 'gying nger 'greng bas gsar skyes gzhon gyi snying stobs mtshon/ /yal 'dab brkyangs te mkha' yi nyin byed dbang bo'i tsha gdung bkag /rtsa ba rgyas nas gser ldan 'dzin ma'i rin chen nor bu srung / /dgos 'dod re ba'i 'bras bu sa gzhi kun la gtor nas yod/ /77
yin yang 'jigs rung gshed mas ma gzod lus la bltas tsam gyis/ /gzugs mdzes gzhon nu bdag la mthu nus ldan pa rtogs gyur pas/ /rno gcod sta res lto bar bsnun te phyi nang srog kyang bcad/ /de'i tshe smre ngag bton kyang thar ba'i re ba ga la yod/ /rgyu 'bras las kyis bral ba'i gsar skyes ljon pa'i dbang bo dag /glo bur nyid du 'jigs rung gshed ma'i lag nas 'chi dgos kyang / /sdig gcod gshed mar bden don khrims kyis nges len mi byed pas/ /deng 'dir smre ngag mi 'don blo thabs gzhan zhig gang nas 'tshol/ /78
bstod tshig me tog chun po/go2bod ljongs gzhon nu tshags pa༄bklags rjes/rab yangs krung hwa mes rgyal 'dzin ma'i stor/ /sna tshogs me tog gsar ba lhug por bzhad/ /ra yig gnyis pa pad mo'i ge sar la/ /chags pas skyed tshal 'di ko kun las lhag /tang gi thugs rje skya rengs gsar ba'i 'og /srid jus bzang po'i nyi gzhon yar 'phags te/ /gzhon nu pad ma'i lo 'dab rgyas dang lhan/ /tshogs par 'di nyid me tog tshom bur bkra/ /khyed ni gzhon nu dgyes pa'i bdud rtsi dang / /bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byed pa'i gsar gtod mkhan/ /yin phyir gangs ljongs gzhon nu'i yid sems de/ /tshogs par khyed la phyogs 'di e ma mtshar/ /79
ma rig pa la lam ston sgron me dang / /ma shes pa la ji bzhin brjod pa'i tshig /ma thos pa la rab snyan rgyud mangs gdangs/ /ma tshang med pas ngo mtshar stong gis brgyan/ /gnas 'dir rab mdzes me tog mang mchis kyang / /chu skyes pad mo'i 'gran zlar su zhig 'os/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir tshogs par grangs mang yang / /gzhon nu'i tshags par khyed la su mi spro/ /deng phyin gzhon nu'i shes rig las drangs pa'i/ /sna mang rtsom gyi 'dab lag rab rgyas te/ /blo gsal gzhon nu dga' ba'i legs skyes su/ /mi nub brtan cing yun ring gnas gyur cig /80
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/bod ljongs sa mthor dpyid dpal rnam par bzhad/kye kye gson dang gangs ljongs dpyid dpal slebs nas mi lo sum cu'i ring / /gsal gsal blo rig rgyas pa'i gsar skyes gzhon la shes bya'i 'dab brgya lhug por grol/ /dman dman nyam chung blo dman bdag gis snyan rtsom lha rdzas dar dkar ring mo yis/ /bstod bstod rlabs chen bya gzhag gang de'i 'bras bu'i thad la legs pa'i skyes su gsol/ /brjid brjid dbang phyogs lhun po'i phrag nas nyi gzhon dal gyis 'dzum pa yis/ /mdzes mdzes chu skyes pad mo'i 'dab stong ze'u 'bru lhug por bzhad pa'i tshe/ /mtshar mtshar 'jig rten bdag tu bzung ba'i byed po dag gi bla 'dar zhing //81
mthun mthun bod 'bangs phrag brgya'i dpung gis dpyid kyi dpal mo bzhad par byas/ /mtha' mtha' bral ba'i rin chen sa gzhi lag mthil tsam yang thob mi srid/ /mang mang sgo phyugs ji 'dra yod kyang rang la dbang ba'i skal ba med/ /skyid skyid srid jus bzang pos rong 'brog dmangs kyi gdong la 'dzum brtas te/ /legs legs brtson 'grus chu bo'i rgyun las drangs pa'i 'bras bu khur gyis lci/ /skyo skyo ma bu btsan gyis kha bral btang yang kha rog 'dug dgos byung / /dbul dbul zas mngar rul bar gyur yang bro ba zhim pa'i 'du shes bzung / /spro spro deng 'dir dbul phyug mnyam zhing btsan gnyom dbye ba 'byed dka' bas/ /bzang bzang dus rabs gsar bar mgrin pa'i ngag las snyan glu dbang med shor/ /gsar gsar blo gzhon dag gi blo gros gser la mi 'dod btsa' ro chags/ /82
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/brtson brtson shes byar sbyang 'dod me lce drag po 'khyag grang chu yis bsad/ /gces gces gzhon nu deng 'dir rmongs pa'i rgya las grol te slob la 'bad/ /'dzum 'dzum spro ba'i gdong na bde skyid ma nyams yul 'di'i bdag por gyur/ /sngo sngo sprin bral dgu tshigs mtha' la glo bur mi 'dod sprin nag bsdus/ /bden bden drang bo 'dzin pa'i skyes chen 'bangs rnams mgo la rdo char phab/ /'bungs 'bungs dbul phongs phyug bsgyur dag la mi 'dod g.yon gyi zhwa mo gyon/ /'gran 'gran zla bral 'bangs kyis sdang ba'i mig zur bgrad 'di kye ma hud/ /skabs skabs 'di la tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs dbyar skyes rnga gsang ldir ba las/ /mthun mthun mang tshogs rma bya sngon mo'i zlos gar rtsen pa'i skal ba ldan/ /khros khros dgun gyi dgra yis mnar ba'i gsar skyes ljang gzhon yar 'phel te/ /mdzes mdzes nor 'dzin khyon la dpyid dpal gsar du bzhad pa'i snyan pa grags/ /83
dkar dkar gangs ri'i ljongs kyi bzo zhing las rigs gang dang gang gi thad/ /bskyod bskyod snyan grags ba dan srid zhi'i rtse na mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur te/ /mngon mngon deng 'dir skal ldan nyams chung bdag gis mi lo sum cu'i ring /bstod bstod ngo mtshar byas rjes mgrin pa'i ngag las snyan pa'i glu la drangs/ /che che de'u 'bur mang zhing kyag kyog phra ba'i bshul lam ring mo la/ /'jam 'jam snum nag gos kyi na bza' gyon te rlangs 'khor che chung dag /shar shar rgyug pa'i tshul 'di 'jig rten byed po lha gcig de yis kyang / /yang yang blo yis dpag par dka' ba'i snang ba zhig kyang cis mi ster/ /lhung lhung dwangs gtsang chu phran chad med gcig rjes gcig ltar bzhur ba yis/ /shag shag dus rabs rlabs kyi zegs ma mkha' la 'phyo bzhin chu shel dbang bo yang / /rgyas rgyas dkar ba'i mdangs kyis 'gran par ma gzod nub kyi sa 'dzin rtser /dal dal yun gyis bros pa'i tshul 'dir bsam na ji 'dra'i ngo mtshar lags/ /84
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/jibkang bkang nor 'dzin khyon la yongs gtams rgya mtsho chen po'i lto ba ru/ /sprul sprul dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu len par ded dpon dbang bo zhugs/ /'khyug 'khyug g.yu 'brug sngon mo rgyu 'dra'i dwangs gtsang nyal 'gro'i lto ba ru/ /mtho mtho ljid 'degs zam chen 'phangs te 'gro 'ong mi rnams bde la bkod/ /tsha tsha nyin dkar srang lam khrom la sna tshogs zong mang bkram pa yis/ /mtho mtho mkha' yi skar tshogs skyengs te gcig kyang ma lus stabs kyis bros/ /mdza' mdza' mi rigs nga drug dga' spro 'dzum gyis khengs pa'i so phreng ni/ /brjid brjid ke la sha yi phreng ba dag las dpe gzhan srid 'dir dkon/ /yangs yangs mdzes sdug pha mtha' bral ba'i rtswa thang chen po'i khyon de ru/ /'dus 'dus phyugs zog mang po rgyu skar phreng ba gcal du bkram pa bzhin/ /dga' dga' gdong la spro 'dzum rgyas pa'i phyugs rdzi'i ngag gi glu gzhas de/ /yangs yangs gnam sar khyab te rgya bod mi rigs mthun pa'i rgyu ru gyur/ /'jibs 'jibs rna la snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs kyis/ /85
yong yong shar nas slebs pa'i dpyid kyi pho nya'i skad la 'gran nus na/ /grags grags rnga dang gling bu rol mo kun rnams mkho 'dis ci zhig bya/ /snyan snyan de yis lo ngo sum cu'i ring gi rgyal kha'i glu dbyangs mtshon/ /gces gces rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dge 'dun tshos/ /mngon mngon bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan srid zhi'i rtse mor bskyod dang lhan/ /legs legs chos kyi cho ga ma nyams sngon nas da bar spel ba'i tshul/ /'bangs 'bangs dmangs kyi dga' mgu yi rang byed pa'i gnas su gyur 'di mtshar/ /kye kye bod ljongs sa mthor dpyid dpal rgyas te gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur/ /'gyur 'gyur 'di la snyan ngag mkhan gyis bsam bzhin sgro 'dogs byas pa min/ /min min ngo gdong 'dzum gyis khengs te ngo bstod tshig 'ga' brjod min yang / /yang yang bsam zhing bsam na 'pho 'gyur dngos gnas 'di 'dra lags so kye//86
utpal ring nas smon pa'i zla zer/ —4zla zebagasar spel byas nas lo 'khor bcu lon par phul pa/gangs ljongs zhing gi yul grur rtsom rig gshin po'i bzhin nyams mdzes/ /char chu 'dzoms pa'i dus 'dir sna lnga'i 'bras bzang smin par spro/ /lnga phyag zung gi bgrang byar zla ba'i zer brgya yongs spros te/ /rtsom rig mdzes pa'i utpal yul gru 'di la gsar du bzhad/ /gangs ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal sbrang ma'i rtsi yi rgyun bzang mchog /'dzin par spro la dri bral chu skyes padmo khyed nyid kyis/ /blo gsal rkang drug khyu yi yid kyi dbang bo rab myos te/ /ro mchog mngar mo'i ge sar bcud la rol ba'i dus 'di skyid/ /sna mang rtsom mkhan dpung sde utpal mdzes pa'i gling ga der/ /nya gang yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla zer 'od brgya spros pa yis/ /blo gros yangs por phyes te 'dab stong lhug lhug dgod dang lhan/ /gang de'i dpal la bsngags pa'i bka' drin nam yang gzhal yod min/ /87
khyed nyid tshangs pa'i thig gis gangs ljongs grags rtsom tshad 'jal byas/ /khyed nyid bden gtam kyo mas rtsom rig gsar ba'i nying bcud blangs/ /khyed nyid zegs ma 'bar bas sgrung gtam bye ba'i dngos yod bton/ /khyed nyid srid pa'i mthar yang ma myangs dus zhig yod re skan/ /khyed nyid mdzes pa'i yul gru kun lho'i gzhi ru thon pa yis/ /rtsom pa'i las la spro ba'i gsar skyes grogs su bkug dang lhan/ /sna mang rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal bro ba yongs su snom byas te/ /mdza' ba dpung du bsdebs pa'i mi rigs rtsom mkhan 'tshar longs byung / /〈nyi gzhobadagung du 'char te gangs ljongs yul la gzigs mo byas/ /(sbrang cha༄chab rgyun 'jo bas bsil ljongs rig pa'i ljang smyug rgyas/ /〈zla zesamadza' mo grogs su bsdebs te gangs ljongs 'bras bzang smin/ /yod tshad khyed la dbang bas rang rkya thub pa'i skal ba bzang / /e ma zer brgya spros pa'i zla gzhon bod 'bangs phrag brgya yi/ /re ba'i dpal du gyur na tha dad 'gro ba yongs kyi blor/ /ma shes rmongs las grol byed shes rig 'dab ma'i sdong bu zhig /myur ba myur du skyes pa'i yid ches bdag la yod par nges/ /88
pha yul dran pa'i mig chu dbang med bzhur/rab mdzes sa 'dzin brjid pa'i rtse mo la/ /pha mtha' gzhal med a sngon dbyings rim nas/ /nyin byed dbang bo dal gyis 'phags pa yis/ /nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i lus yongs drod kyis khengs/ /sna tshogs sngo ljang ljon shing gseb ka nas/ /dbyangs bdun ma lus rdzogs pa'i khu byug gdangs/ /gyer tshe ri dwags sna tshogs thos 'dzin du/ /'dren pa'i ngang tshul 'di nyid e ma rmad/ /gang sa gang nas bltas kyang pha yul ljongs/ /srid gsum mdzes sdug snying bo ma lus kun/ /gcig tu bsdus 'dra'i gser ljongs gzhong ba de/ /byed pos pir gyis bris pa'i ri mo bzhin/ /89
'brog pa'i gur khyim mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings kyi/ /sprin dkar tshom bu ji bzhin rab mdzes pas/ /ngo mtshar stong gis brgyan pa'i pha yul la/ /blta phyir ngal ba med par rgyu 'di mtshar/ /rtse dgas myos pa'i pho mo gzhon nu tshos/ /rta nor lug gsum sngo ljang spang du 'tsho/ /phan tshun mdza' ba'i glu gzhas len pa der/ /ri skyes bu mo yis kyang rna ba blags/ /ja chang ngoms med btung ba'i rgan rgon tshos/ /phan tshun brtse ba'i snying gtam brjod pa'i tshe/ /rmad byung spyi tshogs gsar ba'i jus bzang zhes/ /mthe bong bsgrengs nas mi bstod gcig kyang med/ /lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i nyal 'gro ma/ /kyag kyog grog rong g.yang sar 'bab pa ni/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo sa la rgyu ba bzhin/ /skye bo rnams kyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /90
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/mtho dma' snyoms pa'i sa zhing gshin po'i ngos/ /smin legs 'bru drug snye ma'i mgo bo dud/ /'jam rlung bsil bu dal gyis ldang ba'i tshe/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs bzhin yid du 'ong / /rang rgyal spyi tshogs gsar ba'i dge mtshan gyis/ /bsam blo rnying ba 'ching rgya las grol te/ /can bzhi 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i gzhung lam steng / /gcig skyod gcig gis rjes su bsnyegs 'di mtshar/ /dus rabs gsar ba'i skal ba bzang po 'dir/ /sha mar thud dang 'bru yis bang mdzod gtams/ /zho dang 'o ma chu gter las mang bas/ /dga' spro dbang med mi skyes su zhig mchis/ /bcu drug lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzhon nu mas/ /rin thang gzhal med gyon gos gsar ba yis/ /bklubs te 'chor sgeg nyams kyi gar bsgyur bas/ /skye bo rnams kyi yid sems ring nas bkug /91
ya rabs spyod tshul drang ba'i gzhon nu tshos/ /ngal ba stong gi snang ba rab dor nas/ /kun gyi re ba ji bzhin skong ba'i slad/ /tshan rig lag rtsal slob pa'i phyogs la brel/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan me tog sna mang gi /dri bsung zhim po sna la drangs pa yis/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi gdung ba sel dang lhan/ /dga' bde'i dpal gyi tshor ba dbang med skyes/ /chu skyes padma'i 'dab ma yongs brkyangs te/ /ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs kun mgron la bkug /ge sar bcud la rol phyir 'phur lding gis/ /gar stabs dbyangs dang lhan du 'du 'god rtsen/ /e ma gces su 'os pa'i pha yul gyi/ /rnam pa zhib mor blo yis dpag dka' bas/ /skal ldan gzhon nu dgyes pa'i legs skyes su/ /rib sa tshe ming 'dzin pas 'di tsam bris/ /92
gangs ljongs dgyes glu/—nubod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsagal phul pa/snyan grags phyogs mtshams kun tu skyi bser rlung ltar rgyu ba yi/ /bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal sgyu ma mkhan gyi 'phrul lta bur/ /drang bo'i gtam gyis bstod tshig me tog pad ma'i chun po zhig /blo dman nyam chung bdag gi mgrin pa'i ngag las 'di tsam thal/ /bod ljongs rig gnas 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i skyed mos dga' tshal du/ /legs 'khrungs dus deb rtsom rig sgyu rtsal bya ba'i ljon bzang la/ /'bras bu smin te longs spyod skal ldan gzhon nu rab myos pas/ /bstod tshig me tog snyim par bzung nas dga' spro'i glu dbyangs len/ /phul byung rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mdzes ldan bu mo gar mkhan mas/ /zlos gar stegs bu'i steng du nyams dgu'i sgyu rtsal ston pa la/ /ltad mor g.yeng ba'i skye bo'i yid kyi skyo snang yongs sel nas/ /bstod tshig pad ma dkar po phyogs mtshams yul gru kun la gtor/ /93
rgod po'i glu gzhas/kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'i dus deb me tog tshom bu'i phon/ /nyam chung bdag gi ngag las bstod par 'os par ma gyur yang / /blo ldan bung ba dus la rol ba'i skal ba bzang po 'dir/ /khyad chos cung tsam brjod pa'i bsam pa bdag la dbang med skyes/ /rab yangs krung hwa mes rgyal mchog gi 'dzin ma'i lto ba ru/ /'od dkar can gyi dus deb 'di nyid mngon par 'phos pa'i tshe/ /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi mun pa rmeg med bcom pa'i mod/ /gsar bzhad rtsom rig ku mud 'dab phreng lhug por dgod 'di mtshar/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi 'gan nus phrag la rab lci ba/ /nyams med bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis 'khor ba khyod/ /snang ba'i 'dod dgu ji bzhin stsol ba'i nyin byed mgon po bzhin/ /ma lus mtha' dag gsal bas snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs la khyab/ /phul byung rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'dzam bu srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ /thon pa'i mkhas pa'i ljags rtsom legs bshad bstan bcos bslab bya kun/ /blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs kyi rmongs pa'i mun pa 'jom pa'i slad/ /bskal pa brgya phrag bar du mi nyams 'phel rgyas yong bar smon/ /94
mdzes pa'i bod ljongs dga' bas lta/a mas nga rang btsas pa'i dus de nas/ /gnas mchog nyi ma lha sa'i gzi byin dpal/ /yang yang gleng ba'i gtam gyi mu tig phreng / /thos 'dzin bu ga'i snyan du ring nas gsol/ /go la zlum po'i rtse mor grags 'bar ba'i/ /gangs ljongs gnas mchog nyi ma lha sa'i grong / /gru 'dzin ri bo'i snyan pa dgung sngon dbyings/ /sgra brgya ldir ba'i dpal kyang zil gyis gzhom/ /phreng bsgrigs yid 'ong sdod gnas khang bzang dag /mdzes sdug ma lus bang rim phreng ltar bsgrigs/ /gzugs brnyan kun mthong dwangs gsal shel gyi ngos/ /sna tshogs snang 'char yid brtan cig car 'phrog /95
rta bong thar dka'i lam phran rdzu shugs kyis/ /khod snyoms bde yangs gzhung lam rgya cher bskrun/ /snum bag 'od 'khyug bkrag ldan bshul lam steng / /sna tshogs rlangs 'khor gcig mgyogs gcig la 'gran/ /mtshan dus lam ngogs 'phyang ba'i glog 'od phreng / /ston mtshan mkha' yi rgyu skar tshogs la 'phya/ /sbag sbag 'phrul gyi 'khor lo'i sgra sna tshogs/ /g.yu 'brug stong gi ldir skad zil gyis mnan/ /rab med skyid chu gtsang bo'i chu rgyun la/ /rdzu 'phrul zol gyis zam chen bde bar 'phangs/ /rin thang gzhal med zong mang drangs pa yis /don mthun spro dgas skyid glu sing sing gyer/ /rig gzhung las la brtson ldan me mched pa'i/ /gsar skyes gzhon rnams skyor sbyong las brel te/ /brda sprod klog gi 'gyur khugs snyan mo'i gdangs/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i pi wang rgyud la 'gran/ /96
srol rgyun snyan ngag gi skor/gangs ljongs gso rig gzhung gi snying bo'i bcud/ /'dzin skyong spel la spro ba lha yi rje/ /lag rtsal mthon po'i rtse la bsnyegs dang lhan/ /zhib 'jug ched rtsom ri bo'i dpangs dang mnyam/ /rab mdzes mu mtha' bral ba'i zhing thang du/ /lo legs snye ma'i mgo lcog ldem pa'i mod/ /rin chen 'bru sna mdzod du gtams dang lhan/ /zhing pa'i thon 'bor zla nas lo bzhin 'phel/ /bi shwa kurma'i pir gyi rtse mo las/ /bris 'dra'i 'tsho ba gsar ba'i dga' tshal du/ /sgor grangs khri las brgal ba'i dud khyim grangs/ /gcig las gcig mang dbyar gyi chu bzhin rgyas/ /gsar 'gyur dpe skrun las don rlabs po che/ /nyin bzhin 'phel ba ngo mtshar ltad mo nyid/ /sa gnas rang skyong jus bzang legs bltar bas/ /bod 'bangs bye ba phyag brgya dga' bas brel/ /97
